# Isaiah Chapter 44 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 28 verses]*

*Spirit poured on offspring; idol-making satire; I have swept away sins; Cyrus as shepherd*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** I am the first and I am the last; besides me there is no god. This chapter spirit poured on offspring.

*-- LOGOS*
